changes.before: Medium shot at the doorway of a modest American home in the late 1920s. One generic young adult man in a plain shirt rests a completed old leather suitcase on the floor, looking ready to carry it outside. Two small baby-carriage wheels are attached to one end of the case, with a retracted wooden handle at the opposite end. The suitcase occupies the middle third with space around it. Soft morning window light, no text, logos or real likeness
changes.after: Medium shot at the doorway of a modest American home in the late 1920s. One anonymous adult mother in a plain long travel coat steps outside, pulling a completed old leather suitcase behind her by its fully extended wooden handle. Two small baby-carriage wheels attached to one end touch the floor and carry the case. The woman, extended handle and rolling case occupy the middle third in soft morning light across the plain doorway.

changes.before: Wide shot of a grand 1970s city department store luggage floor with rows of plain unbranded suitcases on wooden shelves. One generic middle-aged salesman in a 1970s suit stands by the door and points the way out with an open hand, looking politely dismissive. On the floor next to the door is a flat suitcase with small metal casters and a rope tied to its handle. Soft overhead lamp light falls from the left.
changes.after: Medium shot on a 1970s department-store luggage floor. One anonymous store buyer in a plain suit pushes a flat unbranded sample suitcase back across a low wooden counter toward the empty foreground, face firm and unconvinced. Its four small metal casters and rope strap stay clearly visible. The buyer is the only person in frame; quiet rows of plain cases recede behind the sample under soft overhead light.

changes.before: Medium shot at a 1970s department store purchasing office with a wooden desk and a blank order pad. One generic buyer in shirt sleeves shakes his head with a firm, unimpressed expression and pushes a flat caster-wheeled suitcase back across the floor with his foot. Mild desk lamp light falls from the left.
changes.after: Medium shot inside a wood-paneled 1970s executive office with a large wooden desk and carpet. One anonymous middle-aged man in a three-piece suit stands beside a flat unbranded suitcase on four small metal casters and gently takes its strap in one hand. He studies the sample with open curiosity, body still before trying it. The case, strap and hand are the focus; soft desk lamp light falls from the right.

changes.before: Wide shot of a dim storage room. One generic man in plain work clothes pauses, looking puzzled at an old flat suitcase on four small casters set aside in a corner, with upright two-wheeled suitcases lined up nearby. The four little casters are the focus. Soft lamp light from one side.
changes.after: Medium low-angle shot in a plain late-1980s airport corridor. One anonymous traveler steadies a single upright suitcase by its extended handle. Exactly two wheels are visible at the rear base; the other lower corners are bare and clear in the open floor space. The traveler looks down toward those empty corners. The upright two-wheel case is the sole focal object, lit by cool window light.

changes.before: Medium shot, a late 1990s luggage shop with plain shelves, one generic adult shopper in simple 1990s casual clothes pushing an upright hard-shell suitcase forward with one hand, curious expression, the focal object is the upright suitcase standing on four small wheels, no labels or tags anywhere, mild overcast light from a window on the left
changes.after: Medium three-quarter shot in a sparse late-1990s product demonstration room with a plain wall and open floor. One anonymous adult demonstrator in simple civilian clothes pushes an upright unbranded suitcase straight forward by its handle. The balanced case stays vertical on four small wheels, with the base and forward path easy to see. Soft window light falls from the left across the empty display floor.

changes.before: Medium shot of a luggage shop around the year 2000. One generic adult shop worker gently turns an upright unbranded suitcase sideways, with its four swivel casters changing direction underneath. The worker looks down at the turning wheels with a curious smile. The suitcase occupies the middle third with space around it. Soft window light, no labels, text, logos or real likeness
changes.after: Medium low-angle shot in a sparse product demonstration room around 2000, with a plain wall, open floor and soft window light from the left. One anonymous adult demonstrator gives a single sideways push to an upright unbranded four-wheel suitcase beside the body. Four swivel caster forks beneath the case are visibly turned across its front, and the case shifts laterally while staying vertical. The wheels and sideways hand movement are the focal action.
